name: file_field
label: Hero video
help_text: Optional background video (MP4 recommended). Leave empty to show the hero image only.
inline_help_text: Video too large or high-bitrate? Try Replace, hover a video, choose Clone and edit, then Export and select the result here. Exporting doesn't always shrink the file, so recheck the size/bitrate warning afterwards.

name: image
label: Hero image
help_text: Used as the video poster while the video loads, or as the full background when no video is selected.
inline_help_text: Prefer JPG or PNG at roughly viewport width. HubSpot serves an optimized WebP to supporting browsers automatically.

name: focal_point_x
label: Focal point X
help_text: Horizontal focus when the hero crops (0 = left, 100 = right). Keeps a person or object visible across viewports.

name: focal_point_y
label: Focal point Y
help_text: Vertical focus when the hero crops (0 = top, 100 = bottom).
